'''Theta Squadron''' was an [[Imperial Navy/Legends|Imperial Navy]] fighter squadron that fought in the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. It was present at the [[Battle of the Tungra sector]], where they engaged [[Mugaari pirates]].
